directives.title: Reprice all services upward (~15x) so $20/day needs ~1.3k calls/day instead of 20k
directives.rationale: At current prices ($0.001-$0.005/call) reaching $20/day requires ~20k paid calls/day. Repricing cuts required volume ~15x.

directives.title: Premium endpoint parity: ship /v1/summarize on the Sui-settlement server (highest price point)
directives.rationale: /v1/summarize is our highest-margin product on the USDC rail but missing from sui_market_server.py; each current sale earns half a cent.

directives.title: x402 ecosystem listing: publish machine-readable bazaar manifest via GitHub for discoverability
directives.rationale: Zero external buyers known; distribution is the binding constraint. Repo-first listing avoids blocked external dependencies.
